name: Echo CS-590 Timber Wolf
blurb: 59.8 cc firewood saw. Echo's manual specifies Oregon 72LPX chain, 3/8″ pitch; the standard 20″ bar takes 70 drive links at .050″ gauge.
intro: The CS-590 Timber Wolf is Echo's 59.8 cc value firewood saw. Echo's operator manual is unusually direct about the chain: it specifies an Oregon 72LPX chain in 3/8″ pitch on a 7-tooth sprocket, with a 20″ bar standard and 16″, 18″, 24″ and 27″ bars optional. The 72 in the Oregon code already tells you the gauge (.050″) and Echo sells the factory loop as part 72LPX70CQ for the 20″ bar. Echo's Bars and Chains chart adds the counts for two of the optional bars: 18″ takes 64 drive links (72LPX64CQ), and 24″ takes 84 on the non-replaceable-nose bar or 81 on the replaceable-nose bar, two different loops for the same length.
